stem.text: A steel ball is falling at constant speed in oil.
Which graph shows the variation with time of the gravitational potential energy $E_\text{p}$ and the kinetic energy $E_\text{k}$ of the ball?

A.alt: Graph of energy against time with origin 0: a horizontal line labelled Ek and a curve labelled Ep that falls from the energy axis.

B.alt: Graph of energy against time with origin 0: a horizontal line labelled Ek and a straight line labelled Ep that falls from the energy axis.

C.alt: Graph of energy against time with origin 0: a curve labelled Ek that rises from the energy axis and a curve labelled Ep that falls from the energy axis.

D.alt: Graph of energy against time with origin 0: a straight line labelled Ek that rises from 0 and a straight line labelled Ep that falls from the energy axis.
